title: Honey Butter Glazed Carrots
description: Tender roasted carrots tossed in a sweet honey butter glaze.
ingredients: 2 lbs carrots, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss carrots with melted butter, honey, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread carrots in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until carrots are tender and lightly caramelized.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

title: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Potatoes
description: Crispy roasted baby potatoes tossed with garlic and parmesan.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss halved potatoes with olive oil, garlic, Italian herbs, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Spread potatoes cut-side down on the baking sheet.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, until golden and crispy, flipping once halfway through.
Remove from oven, toss with parmesan cheese while still hot, and garnish with parsley before serving.

title: Roasted Asparagus with Lemon
description: Simple roasted asparagus brightened with fresh lemon and parmesan.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange asparagus in a single layer, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 10-12 minutes, until tender-crisp.
Remove from oven and squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top, then sprinkle with lemon zest.
Top with parmesan cheese, if using, and serve immediately.

title: Rice Pilaf
description: Fluffy rice sautéed with onion, garlic, and herbs, simmered in broth.
ingredients: 1/4 cup orzo or thin vermicelli, broken (optional)
instructions: Melt butter with olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic and rice (and orzo, if using) and stir for 1-2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Pour in broth and salt, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 18-20 minutes, until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
Remove from heat, let stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and stir in parsley.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
description: Crispy roasted Brussels sprouts with smoky bacon and a balsamic drizzle.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss Brussels sprouts with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread in a single layer on the baking sheet. Scatter chopped bacon over the top.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, stirring once, until sprouts are crispy and bacon is cooked through.
Transfer to a serving dish and drizzle with balsamic glaze before serving.

title: Simple House Salad with Vinaigrette
description: A crisp mixed green salad with a classic red wine vinaigrette.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine salad greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, honey, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle the vinaigrette over the salad just before serving.
Toss gently to coat and serve immediately.

title: Garlic Butter Roasted Broccoli
description: Roasted broccoli florets tossed in garlicky brown butter.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss broccoli florets with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread in a single layer.
Roast for 12-15 minutes, until edges are crispy and browned.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat with garlic and red pepper flakes until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Toss the roasted broccoli with the garlic butter and lemon juice, then serve warm.

title: Herb-Roasted Cauliflower
description: Whole roasted cauliflower florets seasoned with herbs and olive oil.
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss cauliflower florets with olive oil, thyme, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Spread florets in a single layer on the baking sheet.
Roast for 22-25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and tender.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

title: Sautéed Garlic Green Beans
description: Quick-sautéed green beans with garlic and a touch of butter.
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and blanch green beans for 2-3 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the blanched green beans and toss to coat, cooking for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Season with salt and pepper, and top with sliced almonds if using, before serving.

title: Creamed Spinach
description: Rich and creamy spinach with garlic and a touch of nutmeg.
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh spinach (or 20 oz frozen, thawed and drained)
instructions: If using fresh spinach, wilt it in a large pot over medium heat, then drain well and chop.
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat and cook garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in milk until smooth and thickened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper, then fold in the spinach.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through and serve warm.

title: Sautéed Kale with Garlic and Lemon
description: Quick sautéed kale brightened with garlic, lemon, and chili flakes.
ingredients: 1 large bunch kale, stems removed and leaves torn
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add kale in batches, tossing to wilt slightly before adding more.
Cook for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until kale is tender.
Remove from heat and toss with lemon juice, salt, and pepper before serving.

title: Honey Glazed Roasted Parsnips
description: Sweet roasted parsnips with a honey and thyme glaze.
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into batons
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss parsnips with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread in a single layer.
Roast for 20 minutes, then drizzle with honey and sprinkle with thyme.
Continue roasting for another 8-10 minutes, until golden and tender.
Serve warm.

title: Grilled Zucchini and Summer Squash
description: Charred zucchini and yellow squash with olive oil and herbs.
ingredients: 2 medium yellow summer squash, sliced lengthwise
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Toss zucchini and squash slices with olive oil, garlic, Italian herbs, salt, and pepper.
Grill for 3-4 minutes per side, until tender and grill marks appear.
Transfer to a platter and garnish with fresh basil before serving.

title: Balsamic Roasted Beets
description: Earthy roasted beets tossed in a sweet balsamic glaze with fresh herbs.
ingredients: 2 lbs beets, peeled and cut into wedges
2 tbsp fresh dill or parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Toss beet wedges with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread in a single layer.
Roast for 35-40 minutes, until fork-tender.
Whisk together balsamic vinegar and honey, then toss with the roasted beets.
Garnish with fresh herbs and feta cheese, if using, before serving.

title: Roasted Acorn Squash with Brown Butter
description: Roasted acorn squash rings finished with nutty brown butter and sage.
ingredients: 2 acorn squash, seeded and sliced into rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss squash rings with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and arrange in a single layer.
Roast for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until tender and caramelized.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat with sage leaves, cooking until butter turns golden brown and nutty, about 3-4 minutes.
Drizzle the brown butter and maple syrup over the roasted squash before serving.

title: Sautéed Mushrooms with Garlic and Thyme
description: Buttery sautéed mushrooms with garlic, thyme, and a splash of white wine.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs cremini or button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and cook without stirring for 3-4 minutes to develop color.
Stir in garlic and thyme, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add white wine or broth and cook for 2-3 minutes, until mostly evaporated.
Season with salt and pepper, and garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

title: Skillet Creamed Corn
description: Sweet corn kernels simmered in a rich, buttery cream sauce.
ingredients: 4 cups corn kernels (fresh, frozen, or canned and drained)
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add corn and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the corn and stir to coat, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in half and half, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened and creamy.
Garnish with fresh chives before serving.

title: Braised Red Cabbage
description: Sweet and tangy braised red cabbage with apples and vinegar.
ingredients: 1 small head red cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add cabbage and apple, stirring to combine.
Add apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, cinnamon, salt, pepper, and water.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 35-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender.
Adjust seasoning to taste and serve warm.

title: Roasted Radishes with Herb Butter
description: Roasted radishes lose their bite and turn tender and mild, finished with herb butter.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss radishes with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread in a single layer.
Roast for 18-20 minutes, until tender and lightly browned.
Mix softened butter with chives and parsley in a small bowl.
Toss the warm radishes with the herb butter until melted and evenly coated, then serve.

title: Buttered Peas with Mint
description: Sweet peas tossed in butter with fresh mint, a classic springtime side.
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook peas for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Drain the peas and return them to the pot.
Add butter and toss until melted and coating the peas.
Stir in fresh mint, salt, pepper, and lemon zest before serving.

title: Roasted Root Vegetable Medley
description: A colorful mix of roasted carrots, parsnips, sweet potatoes, and red onion.
ingredients: 2 carrots, peeled and cut into chunks
2 parsnips, peeled and cut into chunks
1 sweet potato, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss all vegetables with olive oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Spread vegetables in a single layer on the baking sheet.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, stirring halfway through, until tender and caramelized.
Serve warm.

title: Lemon Garlic Roasted Artichokes
description: Halved artichokes roasted with lemon, garlic, and olive oil until tender.
ingredients: 4 whole artichokes, trimmed and halved, chokes removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss artichoke halves with olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, zest, salt, and pepper.
Place artichokes cut-side down in a baking dish and cover tightly with foil.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, until a leaf pulls away easily and the base is tender.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

title: Caprese Salad
description: Fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil drizzled with balsamic and olive oil.
instructions: Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a serving platter.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.

title: Cucumber Tomato Salad with Red Wine Vinaigrette
description: A refreshing salad of cucumbers, tomatoes, and red onion in a tangy vinaigrette.
instructions: Combine cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and red onion in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Top with crumbled feta, if using, and serve chilled or at room temperature.
